# stats: `StatsOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout stats FILE --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `stats`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/stats.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/stats.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema stats`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `level` | `integer` (uint32) |  | Pyramid level the planes were read at (0 = full resolution); omitted when 0. |
| `region` | [`Region`](#region) or `null` |  | The rectangle of each plane the statistics cover (level pixel coordinates), when a region was asked for; absent = whole planes. |
| `select` | array of `string` | yes | The selection as given (`c=0`, …); empty = every plane. |
| `bins` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Requested histogram bins (0 = none). Integer data with fewer distinct values in its range uses fewer, one per value. |
| `planes` | array of [`PlaneStats`](#planestats) |  | Per-plane statistics (omitted with `--no-planes`). |
| `channels` | array of [`ChannelStats`](#channelstats) | yes | One aggregate per image and channel. |
| `images` | array of [`ImageStats`](#imagestats) | yes | One aggregate per image over all its selected planes. |
| `mip` | [`Projection`](#projection) or `null` |  | Set with `--mip`: the statistics are of maximum-intensity projections along this axis (per pixel, the largest value over the selected planes); `planes[]` entries are the projections, with the projected axis's index reported as 0. |

## Types

### Region

A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Left edge (column of the first pixel). |
| `y` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Top edge (row of the first pixel). |
| `width` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Width in pixels (at least 1). |
| `height` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Height in pixels (at least 1). |

### PlaneStats

Statistics of one plane.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image index. |
| `level` | `integer` (uint32) |  | Pyramid level (0 = full resolution); omitted when 0. |
| `c` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |
| `z` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Z index. |
| `t` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Time index. |

| `height` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Plane height in pixels. |
| `pixel_type` | [`PixelType`](#pixeltype) | yes | Sample type. |
| `stats` | [`SampleStats`](#samplestats) | yes | Statistics of the plane's samples. |
| `components` | array of [`ComponentStats`](#componentstats) |  | Multi-sample (RGB) pixels: the statistics of each colour component on its own. |

### PixelType

Sample type of one channel value. Names follow OME-XML `PixelType` values.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"int8"` | Signed 8-bit integer. |
| `"int16"` | Signed 16-bit integer. |
| `"int32"` | Signed 32-bit integer. |
| `"uint8"` | Unsigned 8-bit integer. |
| `"uint16"` | Unsigned 16-bit integer (the usual microscope camera output). |
| `"uint32"` | Unsigned 32-bit integer. |
| `"float"` | 32-bit IEEE 754 floating point. |
| `"double"` | 64-bit IEEE 754 floating point. |
| `"int64"` | Signed 64-bit integer. |
| `"uint64"` | Unsigned 64-bit integer. |
| `"complex"` | Complex number of two 32-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `complex`. |
| `"double-complex"` | Complex number of two 64-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `double-complex`. |

### SampleStats

Summary statistics of a set of samples.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Finite samples. |
| `non_finite` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | NaN and infinite samples (excluded from everything else). |
| `min` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Absent when there are no finite samples (as are mean, std, percentiles). |
| `max` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Largest finite sample. |
| `mean` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Mean of the finite samples. |
| `std` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Population standard deviation. |
| `percentiles` | [`Percentiles`](#percentiles) or `null` |  | 1st, 5th, 50th, 95th and 99th percentiles. |
| `exact` | `boolean` | yes | True when the percentiles and histogram are exact (see the module documentation). |
| `zero_fraction` | `number` (double) | yes | Fraction of finite samples equal to 0. |
| `saturated_fraction` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Integer pixel types: fraction of samples at the saturation level (`saturation_level`): the detector's ceiling 2^bits − 1 when the file records its significant bits (16383 for 14-bit data stored as uint16), else the type's maximum (255 for uint8, 65535 for uint16, …), i.e. clipped by the detector or the digitizer. |
| `saturated_count` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Integer pixel types: the number of samples at `saturation_level` (exact; use it for "how many pixels are saturated"). |
| `saturation_level` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The value a sample must equal to count as saturated (integer pixel types). |
| `saturation_basis` | `string` or `null` |  | Why that level: `significant_bits` (2^bits − 1 from the bit depth the file records; `saturation_source` names the field) or `pixel_type` (the type's maximum: no bit depth recorded, channels of different depths merged, or values above the recorded depth). |
| `saturation_source` | `string` or `null` |  | For `significant_bits`: the `info` field the bit depth came from, e.g. `images[].extra.component_bit_count` (CZI) or `images[].extra.bits_significant`. |
| `histogram` | [`Histogram`](#histogram) or `null` |  | Present when histograms were requested (`bins` > 0). |

### Percentiles

NumPy-style percentiles of the finite samples.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `p1` | `number` (double) | yes | 1st percentile. |
| `p5` | `number` (double) | yes | 5th percentile. |
| `p50` | `number` (double) | yes | Median. |
| `p95` | `number` (double) | yes | 95th percentile. |
| `p99` | `number` (double) | yes | 99th percentile. |

### Histogram

A histogram of the finite samples.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` | [`HistogramScale`](#histogramscale) | yes | Linear or logarithmic bin spacing. |
| `edges` | array of `number` (double) | yes | `bins + 1` bin edges; bin `i` is `[edges[i], edges[i+1])`, the last bin includes its upper edge. |
| `counts` | array of `integer` (uint64) | yes | Samples per bin (`bins` entries). |
| `nonpositive` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Log scale only: samples ≤ 0, which have no place on a log axis. |

### HistogramScale

Spacing of histogram bin edges.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"linear"` | Equal-width bins from `min` to `max` (integer data: to `max + 1`, so each bin holds whole values). |
| `"log"` | Geometrically spaced bins from the smallest positive value to `max`; values ≤ 0 are counted in `nonpositive`. Suited to data spanning decades (photon counts, spectra). |

### ComponentStats

Statistics of one colour component of interleaved multi-sample (RGB) pixels.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sample` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Sample index within a pixel: for RGB 0 = red, 1 = green, 2 = blue (every reader returns R, G, B order; CZI's stored B, G, R is swapped on read). |
| `name` | `string` or `null` |  | `red`, `green`, `blue` (and `alpha`) for 3- and 4-sample pixels. |
| `stats` | [`SampleStats`](#samplestats) | yes | Statistics of that component's samples only. |

### ChannelStats

Statistics of every selected plane of one channel.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image index. |
| `c` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |
| `name` | `string` or `null` |  | Channel name, if recorded. |
| `image_name` | `string` or `null` |  | Name of the image (scene, series, position) the channel belongs to, if recorded. |
| `planes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Number of planes aggregated. |
| `stats` | [`SampleStats`](#samplestats) | yes | Statistics over those planes (RGB: every colour sample pooled). |
| `components` | array of [`ComponentStats`](#componentstats) |  | Multi-sample (RGB) pixels: the statistics of each colour component on its own (`components[0]` = red, `[1]` = green, `[2]` = blue). |

### ImageStats

Statistics of every selected plane of one image (the selection aggregate).

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image index. |
| `name` | `string` or `null` |  | Image (scene, series, position) name, if recorded (`info` → `images[].name`). |
| `pixel_type` | [`PixelType`](#pixeltype) | yes | Sample type. |
| `planes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Number of planes aggregated. |
| `stats` | [`SampleStats`](#samplestats) | yes | Statistics over those planes. |
| `components` | array of [`ComponentStats`](#componentstats) |  | Multi-sample (RGB) pixels: the statistics of each colour component over those planes (`components[0]` = red, `[1]` = green, `[2]` = blue). |

### Projection

The axis of a maximum-intensity projection (`stats --mip z`).

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"z"` | Along z: one projected plane per image, channel and time point. |
| `"t"` | Along t: one projected plane per image, channel and z. |
